description: Applies an action from Meshy's animation library to a previously rigged Meshy character (Meshy Animate).

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

action_id.description: Identifier of the animation action to apply. See https://docs.meshy.ai/en/api/animation-library.

rig_task_id.description: The id of a successfully completed rigging task; the character will be animated.
